title: jmap-server: dispatcher check for object-history arguments without the URI (decision 18)
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H23. Crates: jmap-server. Size: S.

Decision 18 (resolves D2, JMAP-tna1.3.7): the same shape as decision 2's conditional check. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §5 'Dispatcher check (decision 18)' and 'Error mapping', §9 Breaking changes, §10 srv contract tests.

Add one dispatcher check in jmap-server that runs for every deployment, whatever the registration (plain register_<x>_handlers or register_<x>_handlers_with_history), when urn:ietf:params:jmap:object-history is not in the request's using:
- */get: includeReplaced: true or includeDestroyed: true => invalidArguments
- */query: onlyDestroyed: true, or a non-null destroyedAfter or destroyedBefore => invalidArguments
- */set: a non-empty restore => invalidArguments
false, null and empty values ({} for restore) are accepted and removed before the handler runs. On rejection the handler is not called. Other history arguments (historyAfter, historyBefore, historySkip, historyLimit) are not checked: §3 ignores them when both flags are false. Place it beside conditional's decision-2 check; share its structure if conditional C3 (JMAP-y1yu.3) has landed, otherwise keep it independent. No name collisions in the crates or Mark's drafts (decision 18).

Acceptance:
- Dispatcher tests with probe Foo/get, Foo/query and Foo/set handlers: every rejected case gives invalidArguments and the handler is not called; every accepted default reaches the handler without the key.
- The same results with plain and _with_history registration; with the URI in using the check does nothing.
- CHANGELOG [Unreleased] "Changed" entry: wire behaviour change on every deployment (as decision 2); public-api additions only.
